</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

This forces handlers to manually reclassify them, a process that introduces delays and creates a significant risk that critical evidence will be overlooked during claims processing, undermining claim accuracy.\n\n## Who is affected\n- **Claims handlers** who must spend time manually reassigning misfiled documents, risking evidence being missed during review [i:a84a3c32af64b2f1].\n- **5 accounts** currently using Keelwater's claims-handling software, with a combined Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) of £3520000.0 [i:10727c617a1f4506][i:5109cfcbf29475a5][i:6f60a28973334f3b][i:7102b8f7695fc01f][i:a84a3c32af64b2f1].\n- **Account success teams** across 3 routes: support, onboarding, and account management, who have received mentions of this issue [i:10727c617a1f4506][i:7102b8f7695fc01f][i:9376988159edff55].\n\n## Evidence\n- The fact sheet shows 5 accounts have raised this issue [i:10727c617a1f4506][i:5109cfcbf29475a5][i:6f60a28973334f3b][i:7102b8f7695fc01f][i:a84a3c32af64b2f1].\n- Saltmarsh Specialty (ARR: £740000.0) has mentioned it, stating, \"Garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it\" [i:10727c617a1f4506]. They also note that \"handlers are wasting time fixing incorrect file type assignments, and it’s impacting claim accuracy\" [i:71622a189d0b930d].\n- Linnet House Insurance (ARR: £360000.0) has mentioned it, reporting that \"garage estimates keep landing in Correspondence, and our handlers have to manually move them, which risks missing critical evidence\" [i:91a13e0608c068d5].\n- Brackwater Homecover (ARR: £610000.0) has mentioned it, stating, \"Every time we upload a garage estimate, it lands in correspondence — it’s a wrong document category and handlers keep missing key evidence because of it\" [i:a3f2a53f98cd8130].\n- Cindermill Trade Cover (ARR: £210000.0) reported during onboarding that \"Uploaded documents are sometimes misfiled — garage estimates get dumped into correspondence, forcing handlers to manually reassign them, and that’s where evidence can slip through the cracks because of ... file type assignment\" [i:7102b8f7695fc01f].\n- Marrowgate Commercial (ARR: £1600000.0) reported during onboarding that \"when we upload garage estimates, they’re landing in the wrong document category—like under Correspondence—and we’re having to manually move them, which risks things slipping through the cracks... they’re being auto-sorted into the wrong document category, which forces us to manually reassign them — and sometimes that leads to important evidence being missed during review\" [i:a84a3c32af64b2f1].\n- The fact sheet shows the issue has been reported via 3 routes: 8 times through support, 2 times through onboarding, and 1 time through account management [i:10727c617a1f4506][i:7102b8f7695fc01f][i:9376988159edff55].\n\n## Why now\n- One of the 5 affected accounts, Marrowgate Commercial, has a renewal date of 2026-12-12 [i:a84a3c32af64b2f1].\n- There has been 1 renewal in the last 90 days among the affected accounts [i:10727c617a1f4506][i:5109cfcbf29475a5][i:6f60a28973334f3b][i:7102b8f7695fc01f][i:a84a3c32af64b2f1].\n- The most recent mentions from Saltmarsh Specialty and Brackwater Homecover occurred in late October 2026, indicating the issue is current and actively impacting handler workflow and claim accuracy [i:10727c617a1f4506][i:a3f2a53f98cd8130].\n",

The ARR figures (£740k, £360k, £610k, £210k, £1.6m, total £3.52m), account count (5), route counts (support 8, onboarding 2, account management 1), Marrowgate's renewal date (2026-12-12), and the 1 renewal in 90 days all match the fact sheet.
